model_annotation: This line diagram illustrates the relationship between trajectory length and the variable gamma (γ). The red line begins at approximately (0.86, 17) and ends at (1.00, 21), exhibiting a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations. The blue line starts at around (0.86, 16) and ends at (1.00, 20), also showing a generally increasing trend.
